name: Queen Cliodna

facts.text: Level 70, 30,000 health, in the Bog of Cullen. She casts Dark Blast (400 cold) and a stun, and stays within a tether of 2,600.
Irish myth (not game canon): Clíodhna is a queen of the sídhe whose three birds sing the sick to healing sleep.
Bot chat: her birds sing people to sleep; keep your distance.

story: The old songs remember Cliodna as a queen of the sídhe whose three bright birds sang the sick to sleep and woke them well. The Cliodna of the Bog of Cullen remembers the songs too, and keeps the half she liked. Her voice still brings sleep: those who come too close stand stunned in the reeds, unable to lift a hand, while the cold of her court settles over them. She keeps a court of sorts among the pools, though no courtier has been seen there in an age. The Cullen folk leave a little milk on the bog path on her feast night. They do not say for whom.
legend: She stuns, so bring purges and keep a second tank ready to pick her up. Her dark blast is cold over whoever she targets: heal through it. Fight her near her pools; she walks home if drawn too far. Bring friends: her court may be empty, but she is not alone in the bog.

aggro: You come to my court without a gift?

phases.text: Sleep, mortal. My birds will sing for you.

death: My birds... are silent... at last...

lairEntry: Bright birds sing somewhere you cannot see.

phases.text: Queen Cliodna's song drags at your limbs.

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Queen Cliodna's song is ended. The bog is quiet.
